methodological_limits_explicitly_reporte: No optional controller consulted an expert, so the primary matrix does not estimate a dialogue benefit.
The forced exchange establishes execution, not necessity, savings or superiority.
The strict existing-test-file policy and prompt ambiguity can reject functionally correct patches; endpoints are separated.
Four historical issues and two repositories do not support a frontier, equivalence or noninferiority claim.
Shared filesystem isolation is instruction-based, and public-task contamination cannot be excluded.
Luna and Sol are opaque hosted proxies, not evidence of open-weight or local-device performance.
No model learning, many-to-many swarm or native learned-router replication was executed.
Prior art overlaps strongly; the paper makes no first-architecture claim.
Standalone CLI service readiness remains unvalidated; live trials used the collaboration interface.

editorial_revision_requested.issue: The abstract still foregrounds persistent personalization as the remaining empirical question. The latest user scope centers bounded bidirectional conversation and total-cost/performance tradeoffs, with memory optional.
editorial_revision_requested.recommendation: Reframe the abstract around conversational routing and the cost/noninferiority hypothesis; retain personal memory as an optional ablation. Rebuild generated artifacts afterward.
